about.title: About Teranoo ERP Knowledge Hub
about.subtitle: A dedicated documentation, architecture, and knowledge management workspace for Teranoo ERP.
about.purposeBody: This application serves as an authoritative, structured workspace for understanding Teranoo ERP's vision, architecture, approved decisions, research evidence, and independent reviews. It is not an operational ERP system, not a marketing website, and not a plain Markdown viewer.

purposeRows.r1Is: Structured documentation and architecture hub for Teranoo ERP
purposeRows.r2Is: Analytical workspace for decisions, research, and independent reviews
purposeRows.r3Is: Public read-only knowledge platform built incrementally via governed tasks
purposeRows.r3IsNot: Not a plain Markdown viewer or disposable prototype

about.classificationBody: The platform enforces an explicit visual and semantic distinction across four knowledge classifications so advisory recommendations, research evidence, and future considerations are never presented as approved decisions.
about.publicAccessTitle: Approved Product Direction — Public Read-Only Knowledge Platform & Publishing Governance
about.publicAccessBody: By explicit approval of the project owner, Teranoo ERP Knowledge Hub operates as a publicly accessible read-only knowledge-sharing platform for authorized architectural documentation. User authentication is not required for public read-only access, and the application repository may remain public.

publicAccessGuardrails.authorization: Publishing any project document still requires explicit authorization and scope verification.
publicAccessGuardrails.noSecrets: Secrets, API keys, credentials, access tokens, customer data, and sensitive operational information must never be published.
publicAccessGuardrails.attribution: Source attribution and intellectual property notices must be preserved; public repository visibility does not automatically grant an open-source software license.
publicAccessGuardrails.separation: Source repository visibility and deployed application access control are distinct security boundaries.
